title: athyrium skinneri
intro: Athyrium skinneri, commonly known as Lady Fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Athyriaceae. It is native to the Himalayas and parts of China, and is valued for its medicinal properties, including its ability to promote digestion, alleviate respiratory issues, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Athyrium skinneri include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which make it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Athyrium skinneri include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
